title: Care-Stay Charges Borne by the Resident on the Entrance Fee Agreement Annual Tax Letter
content:
On the annual tax letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement**, the care-stay charges stated are those the resident bore: where a long-term care insurer paid toward the window's stays, the stay nightly charges counted are reduced by the insurer's payments; where no insurer paid but a stay refund was paid back to the guest in the window, they are reduced by those refunds; otherwise they stand as counted; the result never falls below 0.00.

## Records read

The resident's **Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement** ledger within the letter's window: payments whose payer is a long-term care insurer, and refunds paid back to the guest.

## Condition table

| Long-term care insurer payment in the window | Stay refund to the guest in the window | Charges borne |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | Charges counted less the insurer's payments, never below 0.00 |
| No | Yes | Charges counted less the refunds, never below 0.00 |
| No | No | Charges as counted |

## Hypothetical windows (stay nightly charges counted 4800.00)

| Insurer payments | Guest refunds | Charges borne |
|---|---|---|
| 3000.00 | 500.00 | 1800.00 |
| 0.00 | 500.00 | 4300.00 |
| 6000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 4800.00 |
